title: SQL 查询与过滤 (Select & Filter)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (1/16)：SELECT、WHERE、LIKE、IN、BETWEEN、NULL、ORDER BY 与 LIMIT，先掌握最常用查询骨架

content.content: SELECT * FROM users;
SELECT id, name, email FROM users;
SELECT name AS user_name, age AS user_age FROM users;
SELECT DISTINCT city FROM users;
SELECT DISTINCT city, country FROM users;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age = 18;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE status <> 'active';
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 100;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount <= 500;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age >= 18 AND city = 'Beijing';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE city = 'Beijing' OR city = 'Shanghai';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE 'Tom%';
SELECT * FROM products WHERE title LIKE '%phone%';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (1, 2, 3, 5);
SELECT * FROM users WHERE status NOT IN ('banned', 'deleted');
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount BETWEEN 100 AND 500;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31';
SELECT * FROM users WHERE email IS NULL;
SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone IS NOT NULL;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY age ASC;
SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY city ASC, age DESC;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 40;
